description: Introspect the API key's own account — effective tier, per-service entitlements, current hour/month quota usage and project count. Use it to check headroom or diagnose a 403/429 before retrying.
name: sm_get_account

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_account tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

code.description: A machine-readable identifier for the error type. For the full code taxonomy, see the sm_get_schema tool or the Enterprise API OpenAPI ErrorResponse component.

entitlements.description: Per-service entitlement rows defining allowed access.

isEnabled.description: True if the current subscription tier permits access.

rateLimitHour.description: The hourly quota boundary for this service.

rateLimitMonth.description: The monthly quota boundary for this service.

service.description: The name of the service this entitlement governs.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

projectCount.description: Number of projects this key can read.

tier.description: Tier information for the enterprise account.

id.description: A varchar tier identifier, typically free/starter/pro/enterprise.

resetHour.description: UTC Unix epoch seconds when the hourly limit resets.

resetMonth.description: UTC Unix epoch seconds when the monthly limit resets.

usedHour.description: Requests utilized in the current hour window.

usedMonth.description: Requests utilized in the current month window.

title: Get account and quotas
